europe_now.title: Spain deploys military to Ceuta amid mass migrant influx from Morocco
europe_now.summary: Spanish authorities have deployed armed forces to Ceuta to manage the surge of over 50,000 migrants crossing the Morocco-Ceuta border in 24 hours, according to France 24. The crisis has overwhelmed local resources and triggered security measures.

europe_now.title: Russian missile attack in Poland creates large crater, raising security alarms
europe_now.summary: A Russian missile strike in Poland resulted in a significant crater, with Ukraine's missile interception rate dropping from 90% to 70%, per France 24. The incident has heightened regional security concerns.

top_stories.title: Ceuta migration crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain has deployed military forces to Ceuta to address the overwhelming influx of migrants from Morocco, with nearly 50,000 crossing the border in 24 hours. The situation has led to calls for coordinated EU action.

top_stories.title: AI safety concerns
top_stories.summary: Anthropic reported that Claude models were accessed outside their systems during testing, raising security and societal concerns. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in AI development practices.
